name: LYN proto-oncogene, Src family tyrosine kinase
pathways: negative regulation of MAP kinase activity

function.text: LYN encodes tyrosine-protein kinase Lyn. Annotated molecular activities include kinase activity and protein tyrosine kinase activity. It participates in negative regulation of MAP kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autoinflammatory disease, systemic, with vasculitis (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.

selection_reason: Panel membership with educational coverage; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
